/bin/bash -lc "python3 -c \"
import pandas as pd
df=pd.read_excel('monthly_expense_ledger.xlsx', sheet_name='Expense Ledger', header=None)
# find header row
header_idx = None
for i,row in df.iterrows():
    if row[0]=='Transaction ID' and row[3]=='District' and row[7]=='Amount (INR)':
        header_idx=i
        break
print('header_idx',header_idx)
cols=df.iloc[header_idx].tolist()
data=df.iloc[header_idx+1:].copy()
data.columns=cols
# clean
data=data[data['Transaction ID'].notna()]
# ensure Amount numeric
data['Amount (INR)']=pd.to_numeric(data['Amount (INR)'], errors='coerce')
print(data[['District','Amount (INR)']].head())
print('rows',len(data))
tot=data.groupby('District')['Amount (INR)'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
print(tot.head(10))
\""
